books.title: A Little Princess
books.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
books.description: Sara Crewe keeps her dignity and kindness even when fortune turns — proving imagination is a kind of wealth.
books.quotesJson: ["Whatever comes, cannot alter one thing. If I am a princess in rags and tatters, I can be a princess still."]
books.reflectionsJson: ["How do you stay kind when circumstances shrink?","What story do you tell yourself to endure hard days?"]

books.title: Anne of Green Gables
books.author: L.M. Montgomery
books.description: Orphan Anne Shirley arrives with an imagination large enough for Avonlea — and a red-haired insistence that beauty belongs everywhere.
books.quotesJson: ["Dear old world, you are very lovely, and I am glad to be alive in you.","Kindred spirits are not so scarce as I used to think."]
books.reflectionsJson: ["What place first felt like home because of imagination?","Who is your kindred spirit?"]

books.title: The Chronicles of Narnia
books.author: C.S. Lewis
books.description: Wardrobes open onto snow and lamp-posts; courage, betrayal, and second chances wait beyond the coats.
books.quotesJson: ["Wrong will be right, when Aslan comes in sight.","Once a king or queen of Narnia, always a king or queen."]
books.reflectionsJson: ["What doorway in your life still feels magical?","When have you needed a second chance?"]

books.title: The Secret Garden
books.author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
books.description: A neglected garden awakens with a lonely girl, a boy who speaks to earth, and the quiet miracle of tending what was forgotten.
books.quotesJson: ["If you look the right way, you can see that the whole world is a garden.","Where you tend a rose, my lad, a thistle cannot grow."]
books.reflectionsJson: ["What neglected corner of your life could use a little care?","Who helped you rediscover wonder?"]

books.title: The Velveteen Rabbit
books.author: Margery Williams
books.description: A stuffed rabbit learns that becoming Real takes love, time, and being worn soft by someone who needs you.
books.quotesJson: ["Real isn't how you are made. It's a thing that happens to you.","Once you are Real you can't become unreal again."]
books.reflectionsJson: ["What has love worn soft and Real in you?","Which childhood object still feels alive?"]

books.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
books.author: Lewis Carroll
books.description: A curious tumble down the rabbit hole into riddles, tea, and impossible manners.
